QuestInfo.name: Arcon's Blood?
QuestInfo.1: You find Manji in Perion, but he is unwilling to give you any #bArcon's Blood#k for free. He wants you to go to the underground tunnel in the middle of the island and gather up #b10 Wild Boar Teeth#k first. You practically shiver at how coldly Manji treats you... You almost regret agreeing to help Maya, but no one else seems willing to...
QuestInfo.2: Manji asked for #t04000020# in return for some Arcon's Blood.

0.0: So you want to acquire some #b#t4031005##k? Hah, that's not a task for a nobody like you. You can't obtain #t4031005# unless you're strong... If you really want it, prove me wrong and show me that you are worthy of it...
0.1: Defeat monsters at Wild Boar Land, and then collect #e10#n #bWild Boar Teeth#k. Do you think you can handle it?
0.2: That's right... The #b#t04000020##k looks like this #i04000020#. Get that into your naive little head.

1.0: Hmmm... I may have underestimated you. Alright, here's the #t4031005#, since a promise is definitely a promise. Take it.

yes.0: This bottle contains the blood of an Arcon I slew... Hopefully you'll use it wisely, because it's a rare, precious item...

item.0: If you want the #t4031005# from me, go to Wild Boar Land and bring me #e10#n #bWild Boar Teeth#k. If you don't do that, I cannot possibly hand over the #t4031005# to a rookie like you.
